name: genEigenspace
statement: End R M) (μ : R) : ℕ∞ →o Submodule R M where toFun k

have_tree.body: { i : ℕ // i ≤ k }) (· ≤ ·) fun i ↦ LinearMap.ker ((f - μ • 1) ^ (i : ℕ)) :=

name: genEigenspace_top_eq_maxUnifEigenspaceIndex
statement: End R M) (μ : R) : genEigenspace f μ ⊤ = f.genEigenspace μ (maxUnifEigenspaceIndex f μ)

name: disjoint_genEigenspace
statement: End R M) {μ₁ μ₂ : R} (hμ : μ₁ ≠ μ₂) (k l : ℕ∞) : Disjoint (f.genEigenspace μ₁ k) (f.genEigenspace μ₂ l)

name: generalized_eigenvec_disjoint_range_ker

name: map_smul_of_iInf_genEigenspace_ne_bot
statement: Type*} [SMul R L] [FunLike F L (End R M)] [MulActionHomClass F R L (End R M)] (f : F) (μ : L → R) (k : ℕ∞) (h_ne : ⨅ x, (f x).genEigenspace (μ x) k ≠ ⊥) (t : R) (x : L) : μ (t • x) = t • μ x

have_tree.type: ⨅ x, g x ≤ g x ⊓ g (t • x)
have_tree.body: le_inf_iff.mpr ⟨iInf_le g x, iInf_le g (t • x)⟩

name: map_add_of_iInf_genEigenspace_ne_bot_of_commute
statement: Type*} [Add L] [FunLike F L (End R M)] [AddHomClass F L (End R M)] (f : F) (μ : L → R) (k : ℕ∞) (h_ne : ⨅ x, (f x).genEigenspace (μ x) k ≠ ⊥) (h : ∀ x y, Commute (f x) (f y)) (x y : L) : μ (x + y) = μ x + μ y

have_tree.type: ⨅ x, g x ≤ (g x ⊓ g y) ⊓ g (x + y)
